subject: Activation cadence & accountable owners — ClearWave MAP
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@clearwave.io>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Ryan O'Connell <ryan.oconnell@clearwave.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Activation cadence & accountable owners — ClearWave MAP

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the great demo yesterday. Ryan and I sketched a short mutual action plan and we wanted to check capacity and owners on your side so we can lock dates. High level asks:

- Can Redwood commit to a three-week activation sprint (sandbox -> pilot -> go-live)?
- Who will be the primary engineering contact for the integration and who owns data retention/audit evidence?
- Any known blockers (network/VPC, SOC2 evidence) we should schedule early?

We attached a simple checklist we used for previous pilots. Would love a one-page owner list and a proposed kickoff week by end of week.

Thanks —
Elena Morris
Head of Product Operations
ClearWave Analytics

Attachments: MAP-checklist-v2.docx
From: aisha_rahman@redwood-inference.com
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@clearwave.io>, Ryan O'Connell <ryan.oconnell@clearwave.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood-inference.com, mina_haddad@redwood-inference.com, markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation cadence & accountable owners — ClearWave MAP

Hi Elena / Ryan —

Appreciate the checklist — pleased to see the scope aligns with our typical activation pattern. Below is a compact mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed timeline. Please call out anything missing.

Proposed activation cadence (target = 3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (prep, <1 week) — Kickoff & access:
   - Owner (Redwood): aisha_rahman — schedule kickoff, HubSpot intake, stakeholder roster
   - Owner (ClearWave): Elena Morris — provide env details, test data sample
   - Deliverables: signed NDA (if applicable), access matrix, network allowlist

2) Week 1 (integration, 3 business days) — API integration + VPC connectivity:
   - Owner (Redwood Eng): markus_klein — integration support, test endpoints
   - Owner (ClearWave): Ryan O'Connell — test dataset, config
   - Deliverables: successful sample inference, latency smoke test

3) Week 2 (pilot, 5 business days) — Pilot run and quality review:
   - Owner (CS): ben_carter — pilot plan, success criteria, weekly sync
   - Owner (ClearWave): Elena Morris — user acceptance and feedback loop
   - Deliverables: pilot report, prompt/eval baseline, quantization notes if applicable

4) Week 3 (go-live prep & cutover, 2–3 days) — SLA and ops handover:
   - Owner (CS/Operations): mina_haddad — runbook, escalation path, cost/reporting cadence
   - Deliverables: go-live checklist, acceptance sign-off, DocuSign for SOW (if required)

Asks from Redwood:
- Please confirm a preferred kickoff week (we have capacity starting Mon, Mar 8 or Mon, Mar 15).
- Confirm whether ClearWave requires private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or hosted API for pilot. That changes lead time for network work.

I attached an activation roster stub (Activation_Roster_v1.xlsx) with suggested owners and contact numbers. Ben and Mina — can you validate the owners and add any suggested contingency owners? Markus — note the tentative integration slot in week 1; confirm if the team needs extra lead time.

Best —
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Activation_Roster_v1.xlsx
From: aisha_rahman@redwood-inference.com

Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Activation cadence & accountable owners — ClearWave MAP

Folks — forwarding ClearWave ask + proposed MAP. Quick internal notes (please reply-all with confirmations):

- Ben: pilot success criteria — can you add the two measurable KPIs we want to track (latency p95 target, qualitative accuracy threshold)? Keep it tight so ClearWave can sign off.
- Mina: ops/runbook — please attach the incident bridge template and confirm on-call coverage for the first 30 days post go-live.
- Markus: engineering — is the week-1 slot (Mar 8 kickoff) feasible or do you need to push to Mar 15? Also call out any prework for VPC certs.

Subject: Re: Activation cadence & accountable owners — ClearWave MAP

Elena / Ryan —

Thanks — this looks good from CS. Quick updates and confirmations:

- KPIs for pilot: p95 latency <= 450ms (1–2 token warm cache), and human-rated relevance >= 80% on 200-sample eval (owner: ben_carter).
- Ops coverage: Mina confirms a 30-day rolling on-call with 8x5 escalation to engineering, and a post-go-live 2-week daily check-in (owner: mina_haddad).
- Engineering availability: Markus confirmed team can support week of Mar 15 kickoff (we prefer Mar 15 to allow a 1-week prep on internal certs).

Next steps (agreed action items):
1) ClearWave to confirm deployment preference (hosted vs VPC) by EOD Tue, Mar 2.
2) Redwood to share runbook + incident bridge template (Mina) and final activation roster (Aisha) by Wed, Mar 3.
3) DocuSign SOW to be issued after ClearWave confirms deployment choice. Link will be shared.

We are happy to lock Mar 15 as the kickoff. Elena — can you confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite with agenda?

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
